newsitem.title: USA: Paxar to buy rest of Monarch Marking for $130 million.
newsitem.headline: Paxar to buy rest of Monarch Marking for $130 million.

text.p: Paxar Corp., a maker of labels and bar code tags for clothes, said Friday that it will buy the 55 percent of Monarch Marking Systems it does not already own for $130 million in cash, warrants and Paxar common stock.
Paxar said it reached an agreement with the private investment firm of Odyssey Partners LP and an agreement in principle with Monarch Marking Systems to buy their equity ownership in Monarch.
Paxar said the acquisition should close in mid-February after clearing the federal antitrust waiting period. It said no organisational changes are planned after the acquisition.
Ohio-based Monarch supplies bar codes to retail and industrial customers.
Paxar said Monarch has added significantly to its earnings since its initial acquisition in 1995.
Paxar shares were up $1.125 at $17.875 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
